headline: 珍奶遭滅口！室友竟稱試毒
ticker: 整杯失蹤只剩冰塊｜室友自封試毒專員｜珍珠主權全面告急
anchor_script: 快訊！一杯珍奶，掀翻合租信任！苦主返家，只見空杯與無辜室友。對方竟辯稱：我是幫你試毒！試到奶茶見底，珍珠全數失聯！本台獨家重演，吸管就是關鍵凶器！苦主當場祭出冰箱封鎖令，室友還要求頒發英勇勳章！究竟是捨身救人，還是嘴饞奪權？全國飲料保衛戰，此刻升級！
cast: The drink owner is a 24-year-old woman with a short black bob, a yellow T-shirt, and blue jeans; her roommate is a 25-year-old man with short curly brown hair, a green sweatshirt, and gray sweatpants.

shots.scene_en: In a shared apartment kitchen, the woman with a short black bob, yellow T-shirt, and blue jeans freezes before an empty clear bubble tea cup containing only ice, filmed in a dramatic low-angle close-up with no text, letters, or logos visible.

In the same kitchen, the man with short curly brown hair, green sweatshirt, and gray sweatpants noisily sucks the final tapioca pearl through a plain straw while the woman stares in disbelief, filmed in a tight side-angle two-shot with no text, letters, or logos visible.

Beside the kitchen counter, the man in the green sweatshirt solemnly salutes with one hand and presents the empty cup with the other while the woman in the yellow T-shirt folds her arms, filmed from a heroic low angle with no text, letters, or logos visible.

In the apartment kitchen, the woman in the yellow T-shirt wraps the refrigerator in plain red ribbon while the man in the green sweatshirt reaches toward it in theatrical despair, filmed in a wide frontal shot with no text, letters, or logos visible.

In the kitchen, the man in the green sweatshirt bows expectantly as the woman in the yellow T-shirt ceremoniously places the empty clear cup into his outstretched hands, filmed in a deadpan eye-level medium shot with no text, letters, or logos visible.
